verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a public REST API for inference and for automating management of models, deployments, datasets and training. It provides per-endpoint reference pages with a live "Try it" playground, a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec listed in llms.txt, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.fireworks.ai, and a REST guide for programmatic model upload. The probe 404s only hit generic OpenAPI paths, and the spec is published at gateway.openapi.yaml, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API calls (probes confirm only that the docs and llms.txt are reachable).
